name: RIPPED - THCA-C1 Blend - 12G Disposable - Blackberry Kush - Hybrid
description:
Discover our Blackberry Kush Hybrid Ripped Blend in our massive 12-gram disposable format, combining THCA-C1, THCP, and THC8 with the fruity terpenes of Blackberry Kush. This blend offers a perfect balance of relaxation and mild euphoria, with rich flavors of ripe blackberries and earthy hints. Ideal for unwinding or gentle uplift throughout your day, our generously sized disposable ensures lasting enjoyment. Wrapped in a bold design, it delivers style and superior performance. Get RIPPED effortlessly and savor the smooth, deep taste of Blackberry Kush.

Device

• Custom branded 12 gram disposable

• Twin turbo coils 

• Digital screen displaying battery life

• Anti-clogging chamber

• Large viewing window

Details

• Blackberry Kush (Hybrid)

• 12 Gram Disposable

• RIPPED Live Resin Blend

• High Potency

How to Use

• 5 clicks - ON/OFF

• 2 Clicks - preheat

• Connect device to USB-C cord for charging. Activate device and inhale.

• USB-C cord not included.

Cannabinoids

• THCA-C1

• THCP

• THC8 (Delta-8)

What is THCA-C1?

THCA-C1 Is The Precursor To THC

THCA-C1 is a variant of THCA, the non-psychoactive precursor to THC found in cannabis, distinguished by a slight molecular difference. It converts to THC upon heating, potentially offering unique effects and benefits. Early research suggests it shares THCA's properties like anti-inflammatory qualities, with ongoing studies exploring its distinct pharmacological potential.

What is THCP?

THCP Unforgettable High

Experience an unforgettable high with THCP, the most potent THC cannabinoid. THCP offers immediate and highly psychoactive effects that are approximately 33x as strong as Delta-9.

What is THC8?

THC8 (Delta 8) Is Made From Pure CBD

THC8 (Delta-8) the godfather molecule of the industry, offers a user-friendly experience that is similar to Delta-9. It's perfect for inexperienced consumers and referred to by us as "diet weed" because of its softer effects on the body and mind while providing all the benefits of actual cannabis. THC8 is made from pure CBD isolate and is another magical gift from these amazing hemp plants.

🧪Full Panel COA 📋 

RIPPED - Blackberry Kush

THCA Disclaimer

This product is not available for shipment to the following states: Hawaii, Idaho, Minnesota, Oregon, Rhode Island, Utah, and Vermont.
